_doc: Reference medians (P1-032, MAP_REPAIR.md 'OSM is the starting point'): the divider between the two carriageways of a divided street, read from photos (the area sheets' reference boards, harness/design/areas/) or satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery export at 0.285 m per pixel, the judge tool's source). Read by the mesh step (tools/bake/mesh/medianfaces.ts, tools/bake/sources/meshstage.ts readMedianRefs). names: the street names (both carriageways' OSM names) it covers; box: optional lat/lon box that limits it to the stretch it was read on; width: the divider from kerb face to kerb face in metres; type: kerb (raised, paved), planter (raised, green), barrier (a low block or jersey line), painted (flat, drawn raised as a low kerb for now). Where OSM's two carriageways leave more room than the divider and its two kerbs, the lane model gives that room to the lanes (P1-034, tools/bake/roads/dividers.ts: a lane more where a street's space holds one, then wider lanes up to 4.5 m) and only what they cannot take stays carriageway asphalt either side of the divider; where they leave less, the median fills the gap and the entry is listed as a disagreement in health.json mesh.medians.disagree. Streets with no entry take the width OSM's two centre lines leave (source osm).
